craft_notes: Sthāyin: retreat-wonder (faculties turning back). Sanskrit first: list-then-correlative (yaṃ...tam) → L4 lists five, colon, turns. Rows: row 3 (whom/him frame kept as seeing-him/whom). Rupture: colon after store — retinue gathered, retreat stated. Close: end-weight on worship (adore). Minimal pass: colon for L3 dash. Read aloud: five-beat list, turn, bow. Rejected: 'soul' for ahaṃ — killed: I-sense kept (ego, not soul); 'flee' for turn back — killed: retreat is reverent, flight is fear.

lines: Mind, thought, and I, breaths, senses' subtle store:
they turn back seeing him — the worship-worthy we adore.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mano buddhir ahaṃ prāṇās tanmātrendriyajīvanam / yaṃ dṛṣṭvā vinivartante tam upāsyam upāsmahe

reads_against.argmap: All faculties turn back having seen him — the worship-worthy whom we worship.
c1_essence: All faculties turn back before the worship-worthy we worship.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta tipping into śānta (wonder settling into quiescence)
